shortDescription: The FTSE 100 Index went up by 80 points or 0.75 percent on Monday to close at 10739 points.The rise was led by Metlen Energy & Metals (4.16%), Marks & Spencer (3.72%) and Rolls-Royce (3.54%).On the downside, the weakerst performers were BP (-2.91%), Glencore (-2.27%) and Fresnillo (-1.78%).
